## Solid State Drive

Enhanced Reliability

5-Year Warranty

Extreme Performance

Non-volatile NAND up to 30 times more robust than HDDs

Extended protection and peace of mind

NVMe Gen5 transfer speed, faster than a traditional SSD

PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS

CS2150 SOLID STATE DRIVES The CS2150 M.2 NVMe Gen5 x4 Solid State Drive is designed to be an exception ally high performance SSD that delivers the transfer speed your desktop system deserves. It is the ideal solution for PC enthusiasts, amers, and content creators to upgrade to the latest in NVMe technology. The NVMe Gen5 x4 interface delivers performance of up to 10,300MB/s Seq. read and 8,600MB/s seq. write speeds.

Offered with an optional extruded aluminum heatsink, It is designed to be an extreme high performance SSD to deliver the performance you demand for your laptop or desktop system. Boot up in seconds, enjoy lightning fast application launches, and incredible system performance. The PNY CS2150 is highly durable, less likely to fail, and features a 5-year warranty.

The PNY CS2150 is engineered with the same level of quality and durability that our customers have enjoyed for over 35 years. We've taken the world's most advanced NAND flash and refined the CS2150 for optimized performance and reliability. PNY's extensive testing and rigorous validation process ensures compatibility across various platforms and multiple operating systems.
